scenario: A visitor is refused on every admin API route
steps: 1. Call each route of /api/admin/v1 without signing in
expected: 401 on every route, no data

scenario: A signed-in learner who is not the admin is refused
steps: 1. Call each route as a learner
expected: 403 on every route, no data

scenario: The admin session can call the routes
steps: 1. Call GET list routes as the admin
expected: 200 with the envelope

scenario: A valid admin API key works and carries its role
steps: 1. Call a route with the key in the Authorization header
expected: 200; an invalid, revoked or malformed key gets 401

scenario: Every route declares one permission and the owner holds all of them
steps: 1. Read the permission list from the OpenAPI document
expected: Each operation lists a permission (for example courses:write); the owner role has every one

scenario: The API key secret is shown once and only its hash is stored
steps: 1. Create a key 2. Read the key list 3. Read the table with the service role
expected: The secret appears only in the create answer; the list and the table never contain it

scenario: Every answer uses the envelope and never a stack trace
expected: { success:false, error } with a short message; no file paths or stack lines

scenario: List endpoints page with limit, cursor, q and status
steps: 1. Create 5 records 2. List with limit 2 and follow the cursor
expected: All 5 seen once, in a stable order, filters applied

scenario: Update needs the current version (If-Match) and a stale version is a 409
steps: 1. Read v1 2. Update with v1 3. Update again with v1
expected: First 200 (v2), second 409 and nothing changes

scenario: A repeated generate call with the same Idempotency-Key returns the same batch instead of new codes
steps: 1. POST /coupons/generate twice with one Idempotency-Key
expected: Second answer is 200 with repeated:true and the same codes; a different key makes a new batch

scenario: Bad input is refused with 400 and field errors, and nothing is stored
steps: 1. Send wrong types, missing fields, over-long text and unknown fields to each create route
expected: 400 with the failing fields; no row written, no audit row

scenario: Admin-entered URLs must be https
steps: 1. Save a link with http:, javascript: and data:
expected: All refused with 400

scenario: Hostile text is stored as text and returned escaped-safe
steps: 1. Save <script> and HTML in titles
expected: Stored unchanged as text; JSON content type; never rendered as HTML by the API

scenario: Create, read, update and list a course
steps: 1. POST 2. GET 3. PATCH 4. GET list
expected: Fields round-trip; status starts as draft

scenario: A duplicate slug is a 409
steps: 1. Create two courses with one slug
expected: Second is 409

scenario: Publish, unpublish and archive follow the allowed transitions
steps: 1. Publish a draft 2. Unpublish 3. Archive 4. Publish an archived course
expected: Allowed ones 200; draft to archived-to-published refused with 422

scenario: A course with enrolments cannot be deleted, only archived
steps: 1. Enrol a test user 2. DELETE the course
expected: 422 with a message; archive works; a course with no enrolments can be deleted

scenario: Duplicate copies a course as a draft with a new slug
steps: 1. POST duplicate
expected: New draft, same content, no enrolments, audit row

scenario: Create a cohort with a single-price model
steps: 1. POST a cohort with kind single
expected: Stored; enrollmentClosed and listed flags round-trip

scenario: Create a cohort with plans (Community and Personal)
steps: 1. POST kind plans with two plans
expected: Stored; plan ids unique within the cohort; duplicates refused with 400

scenario: The private links are returned only by the links action
steps: 1. GET the cohort 2. GET links
expected: whatsappLink and liveLink are absent from the first and present in the second (admin only)

scenario: A plan or price that leaves an amount above zero and below the payment minimum is refused
steps: 1. Save a plan with a price of 0.40 rupees
expected: 400; a price of 0 or at least the minimum is accepted

scenario: A plan used by enrolments cannot be deleted, only archived
steps: 1. Enrol with the plan 2. Delete the plan

scenario: Open and close enrolment
steps: 1. Close 2. Open
expected: Flag changes, audit rows written

scenario: A coupon without an expiry, or with a past expiry, is refused
steps: 1. POST with no expiresAt 2. POST with a date in the past
expected: 400 both times

scenario: Open-for-all coupon with a percentage discount; codes are case-insensitive and unique
steps: 1. POST kind everyone, percent 20
expected: Stored; percent must be 1 to 100

scenario: Open-for-all coupon with a fixed discount in INR and/or USD
steps: 1. POST fixed with inr 200
expected: Stored; amounts must be positive

scenario: A selected-students coupon needs at least one signed-up user, resolved by e-mail
steps: 1. POST kind selected with no users 2. With two real users 3. With an unknown e-mail
expected: 400, 200 storing Clerk ids, 400 for the unknown e-mail

scenario: Add and remove selected students on a live coupon
steps: 1. PATCH the list
expected: Change is immediate; removed user is refused at validation

scenario: Generate many one-time codes in one call
steps: 1. POST generate count 25
expected: 25 unique random codes of the agreed length and alphabet, each unused with the expiry; count limited (for example 200)

scenario: A one-time code is reserved by the first payer and consumed once
steps: 1. Learner A creates an order with the code 2. Learner B tries the code 3. A pays
expected: B is refused while it is reserved; after A pays it is redeemed with who and when; nobody can use it again

scenario: An abandoned payment releases a one-time code
steps: 1. Create an order 2. Let the hold expire or cancel
expected: Code is unused again and can be used by someone else

scenario: Two parallel uses of one one-time code give exactly one success
steps: 1. Fire 5 parallel create-order calls with the code from 5 sessions or repeats
expected: One reservation, the rest refused

scenario: A coupon list shows unused, reserved, redeemed (by whom, when), expired and voided
steps: 1. Read the list in each state
expected: State and redeemer shown; a used code can be voided only if unused

scenario: A coupon limited to some cohorts or plans is stored with its scope; a discount that leaves an amount above zero and below the minimum is refused from both sides
steps: 1. Create a Personal-plan coupon 2. Use it on Community
expected: Refused with a clear message

scenario: Coupon codes are unique and case-insensitive
steps: 1. Create BIRTH20 and birth20
expected: Second is 409

scenario: Every write adds an audit entry with actor, action, before and after
steps: 1. Create, update, publish and delete a record 2. Read /audit
expected: One entry per write with before and after; secrets never appear in them

scenario: If the audit entry cannot be written the write fails
steps: 1. Simulate an audit insert failure
expected: 500 with a short message and the data is unchanged

scenario: The audit log is read only
steps: 1. Try POST, PATCH and DELETE on /audit

scenario: The spec is served only to the admin or a key
steps: 1. GET /api/admin/v1/openapi.json as each

scenario: Spec and routes match (contract test)
steps: 1. Compare the route files with the spec paths and methods
expected: No route missing from the spec and no spec path without a route

scenario: Each documented status code can be produced
steps: 1. For each operation trigger its documented codes
expected: All reachable

scenario: The docs page is admin only and sends no Swagger code to others
steps: 1. Open /admin/api-docs as each
expected: Redirect or 403 for visitor and learner; page for the admin

scenario: The new tables are locked: no policy, no anon or authenticated grant
steps: 1. Run the policy inventory after the SQL
expected: RLS on, no policies, no grants for the public roles

scenario: The import script copies the courses and cohorts and a re-run changes nothing
steps: 1. Dry run 2. Import 3. Import again
expected: Dry run lists the changes; second import reports zero changes; stored data equals the data files

scenario: Write endpoints are rate limited
steps: 1. Send writes faster than the limit
expected: 429 with Retry-After

scenario: Optional overall limit and scope; a one-time code cannot change its limit
steps: 1. Create with maxRedemptions 50 and 0 2. PATCH the limit of a one-time code
expected: 50 stored, 0 refused, one-time limit change refused
